control_rng: numpy PCG64, SeedSequence([seed, 1398030926, dimension, control_index, block]); control_index=0 permutation, 1 iid
normalization: sum band FFT power / sum all non-DC FFT power, pooled over all independent slices or pixel histories and dimensions within one seed
spatial_band: DFT on 8x8 slice, integer-frequency modes 0<kx^2+ky^2<=2; remove each slice DC; no window (toroidal table)
temporal_band: DFT on length16 history per fixed pixel, integer-frequency modes |kt|=1; remove each history DC; no window
gate_scope: Same v1 gates independently in EACH of 4 blocks; overall PASS requires all blocks. Rank permutation now means floor(sample*1024) is a permutation in every dimension/block. Range [0,1), C++/Python float32 bit-exact agreement and raw-mask hash reuse are additional mandatory sanity gates.
diagnostics_only: 64-frame sequence temporal spectrum at modes |k|=1 (same FFT helper, not a v1 gate on a different length)
adoption_boundary: Actual CPU sample() values from source v2 on 4 named blocks only. Original raw-table result stays FAIL. No GPU execution, frame-performance, rendered-quality or unbounded-convergence claim.
